## What Changed

Oct 30, 19:23 UTC Resolved - This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available. Oct 30, 18:32 UTC Monitoring - The degradation affecting Actions, Pages and Webhooks has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Oct 30, 18:32 UTC Update - All affected services have recovered following mitigation. We continue to investigate root cause. We are monitoring recovery and investigating the underlying cause. Oct 30, 18:00 UTC Update - Pages is experiencing degraded performance. We are continuing to investigate.
